license_required.quote: An individual shall not engage in the practice of medicine or practice as a physician's assistant unless licensed or otherwise authorized by this article.

issuing_authority.quote: the Michigan board of medicine and the Michigan board of osteopathic medicine and surgery shall notify in writing all physicians subject to this section

name.quote: the Michigan board of medicine and the Michigan board of osteopathic medicine and surgery shall notify in writing all physicians subject to this section

type.quote: the Michigan board of medicine and the Michigan board of osteopathic medicine and surgery shall notify in writing all physicians subject to this section

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the department of licensing and regulatory affairs.

age_minimum.quote: Be 18 or more years of age.

degree_required.quote: an applicant, in addition to completing the requirements for the degree in medicine, shall complete a period of postgraduate education to attain proficiency in the practice of the profession

accrediting_body.quote: A medical school approved by the board.

required.quote: an applicant, in addition to completing the requirements for the degree in medicine, shall complete a period of postgraduate education to attain proficiency in the practice of the profession, as prescribed by the board in rules, as a condition for more than limited licensure.

duration.value: as prescribed by the board in rules
duration.quote: shall complete a period of postgraduate education to attain proficiency in the practice of the profession, as prescribed by the board in rules

kind.quote: complete a period of postgraduate education to attain proficiency in the practice of the profession

exams.name: Initial medical licensure examination approved by the board
exams.notes: Required for foreign medical graduates applying for full license under section 17031(2); board sets passing score
exams.quote: the applicant has achieved a score determined by the board to be a passing score on an initial medical licensure examination approved by the board.

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA)
exams.notes: Required for physicians seeking expedited license under the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact; must pass each component within three attempts
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA) within three attempts

required.quote: the board may require a licensee seeking renewal of a license to furnish the board with satisfactory evidence that during the 3 years immediately preceding application for renewal the licensee has attended continuing education courses or programs approved by the board totaling not less than 150 hours

hours_per_period.quote: continuing education courses or programs approved by the board totaling not less than 150 hours in subjects related to the practice of medicine

period_years.quote: during the 3 years immediately preceding application for renewal

topical_requirements.quote: not less than 150 hours in subjects related to the practice of medicine including, but not limited to, medical ethics and designed to further educate licensees... the board shall promulgate rules requiring each applicant for license renewal to complete as part of the continuing education requirement of subsection (1) an appropriate number of hours or courses in pain and symptom management.

available.quote: An individual who is licensed to practice a health profession in another state or in a province of Canada... who applies for licensure... in this state may be granted an appropriate license or registration

requirements.value: Applicant must substantially meet Michigan requirements, be licensed in a state or province with substantially equivalent standards, and may need to appear for an interview.
requirements.quote: The applicant substantially meets the requirements of this article and rules promulgated under this article for licensure... the applicant is licensed, registered, specialty certified, or specialty licensed in another state or is licensed in a province in Canada that maintains standards substantially equivalent to those of this state.

exists.quote: the Michigan board of medicine and the Michigan board of osteopathic medicine and surgery shall notify in writing all physicians subject to this section

regulatory_model.quote: An individual shall not engage in the practice of medicine or practice as a physician's assistant unless licensed or otherwise authorized by this article.

credential_type.quote: An individual shall not engage in the practice of medicine or practice as a physician's assistant unless licensed or otherwise authorized by this article.

is_mandatory.quote: An individual shall not engage in the practice of medicine or practice as a physician's assistant unless licensed or otherwise authorized by this article.

title_protection.quote: the following words, titles, or letters or a combination thereof, with or without qualifying words or phrases, are restricted in use only to those individuals authorized under this part to use the terms and in a way prescribed in this part: "doctor of medicine", "m.d.", "physician's assistant", and "p.a."

scope_protection.quote: An individual shall not engage in the practice of medicine or practice as a physician's assistant unless licensed or otherwise authorized by this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of general duty consisting of negligence or failure to exercise due care, including negligent delegation or supervision, whether or not injury results.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a violation of general duty, consisting of negligence or failure to exercise due care, including negligent delegation to or supervision of employees or other individuals, whether or not injury results, or any conduct, practice, or condition that impairs, or may impair, the ability to safely and skillfully engage in the practice of the health profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice of the health profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substance use disorder affecting the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subject to sections 16165 to 16170a, substance use disorder as that term is defined in section 100d of the mental health code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical inability reasonably related to and adversely affecting the licensee's ability to practice safely and competently.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical inability reasonably related to and adversely affecting the licensee's or registrant's ability to practice in a safe and competent manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lack of good moral character.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Lack of good moral character.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a misdemeanor punishable by imprisonment for a maximum of 2 years, a misdemeanor involving illegal delivery/possession/use of a controlled substance, or any felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a misdemeanor punishable by imprisonment for a maximum term of 2 years; conviction of a misdemeanor involving the illegal delivery, possession, or use of a controlled substance; or conviction of any felony other than a felony listed or described in another subparagraph of this subdivision.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or renewing a license or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or renewing a license or registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting a license or registration to be used by an unauthorized person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting a license or registration to be used by an unauthorized person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice outside the scope of a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice outside the scope of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, possessing, or attempting to obtain a controlled substance without lawful authority; or selling, prescribing, giving away, or administering drugs for other than lawful diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining, possessing, or attempting to obtain or possess a controlled substance or a drug as that term is defined in section 7105 without lawful authority; or selling, prescribing, giving away, or administering drugs for other than lawful diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: False or misleading advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False or misleading advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees for referral of patients or accepting kickbacks on medical or surgical services, appliances, or medications.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing fees for referral of patients or accepting kickbacks on medical or surgical services, appliances, or medications purchased by or in behalf of patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain third-party reimbursement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain third-party reimbursement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any sexual or potentially sexual conduct by a licensee with a patient while acting within the health profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct by a licensee or registrant with a patient while the licensee or registrant is acting within the health profession for which the licensee or registrant is licensed or registered, including conduct initiated by a patient or to which the patient consents, that is sexual or may reasonably be interpreted as sexual

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation to a consumer or patient or in obtaining third-party reimbursement in the course of professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation to a consumer or patient or in obtaining or attempting to obtain third-party reimbursement in the course of professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Betrayal of a professional confidence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Betrayal of a professional confidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to notify the department of criminal convictions or disciplinary actions by another state within 30 days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to notify under section 16222(3) or (4).

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation, or aiding or abetting in a violation, of this article or of a rule promulgated under this article.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation, or aiding or abetting in a violation, of this article or of a rule promulgated under this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in or attempting to engage in human cloning.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of section 16274.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of controlled substance prescribing limits under section 7303a.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of section 7303a(2).

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, treatment, prevention, cure, or relieving of a human disease, ailment, defect, complaint, or other physical or mental condition, by attendance, advice, device, diagnostic test, or other means, or offering, undertaking, attempting to do, or holding oneself out as able to do, any of these acts.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means the diagnosis, treatment, prevention, cure, or relieving of a human disease, ailment, defect, complaint, or other physical or mental condition, by attendance, advice, device, diagnostic test, or other means, or offering, undertaking, attempting to do, or holding oneself out as able to do, any of these acts.

methods_authorized.quote: by attendance, advice, device, diagnostic test, or other means

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe controlled substances; may delegate prescribing authority to physician's assistants under a practice agreement and board rules.
drug_authority.quote: A physician's assistant who is a party to a practice agreement may prescribe a drug in accordance with procedures and protocols for the prescription established by rule of the department in consultation with the appropriate board. A physician's assistant may prescribe a drug, including a controlled substance that is included in schedules 2 to 5 of part 72.

license_status_types.quote: a board may grant the following types of limited licenses upon application by an individual or upon its own determination: (a) Educational... (b) Nonclinical... (c) Clinical academic

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates applying under section 17031(2) must demonstrate 10+ years of practice post-degree, 3+ years of postgraduate clinical training at a WHO-listed institution, a passing score on a board-approved examination, and 2+ years of safe and competent practice under a clinical academic limited license at a Michigan academic institution.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: the board may grant a full license to practice medicine to an applicant who has completed the requirements for a degree in medicine at a medical school located outside the United States or Canada if... the applicant has engaged in the practice of medicine for not less than 10 years after completing the requirements for a degree in medicine.

pain_management_education_required.quote: the board shall promulgate rules requiring each applicant for license renewal to complete as part of the continuing education requirement of subsection (1) an appropriate number of hours or courses in pain and symptom management.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A health professional providing telehealth services may prescribe drugs if acting within scope of practice; if prescribing a controlled substance, must meet applicable requirements; must provide referrals if medically necessary and ensure follow-up availability.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A health professional who is providing a telehealth service to a patient may prescribe the patient a drug if both of the following are met: (a) The health professional is a prescriber who is acting within the scope of his or her practice in prescribing the drug. (b) If the health professional is prescribing a drug that is a controlled substance, the health professional meets the requirements of this act applicable to that health professional for prescribing a controlled substance.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: An allopathic physician who holds an expedited license under the interstate medical licensure compact is authorized to engage in the practice of medicine under this article.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The interstate medical licensure compact is enacted into law and entered into by this state as a party with all jurisdictions that legally join in the compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician's assistant shall not engage in the practice as a physician's assistant except under the terms of a practice agreement that meets the requirements of this section.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A physician's assistant under a practice agreement may prescribe drugs including controlled substances in schedules 2-5, in accordance with department rules and board protocols.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician's assistant who is a party to a practice agreement may prescribe a drug in accordance with procedures and protocols for the prescription established by rule of the department in consultation with the appropriate board. A physician's assistant may prescribe a drug, including a controlled substance that is included in schedules 2 to 5 of part 72.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: If it receives information reported under section 16243(2) that indicates 3 or more malpractice settlements, awards, or judgments against a licensee in a period of 5 consecutive years or 1 or more malpractice settlements, awards, or judgments against a licensee totaling more than $200,000.00 in a period of 5 consecutive years, whether or not a judgment or award is stayed pending appeal, the department shall investigate.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: A notice of revocation, suspension, or limitation of staff privileges or a change in employment status due to disciplinary action by a licensed health facility.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: "Health professional recovery program" or "program" means a nondisciplinary, treatment-oriented program for impaired health professionals established under section 16167.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Failure or refusal to submit to an examination that the department, a disciplinary subcommittee, or a board or task force is authorized to require under this part after reasonable notice and opportunity for a hearing constitutes a ground for denial or suspension of a license or registration until the examination is taken.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: Nonclinical, to an individual who functions only in a nonclinical academic, research, or administrative setting and who does not hold himself or herself out to the public as being actively engaged in the practice of the health profession

investigational_drug_protection.quote: Except in the case of gross negligence or willful misconduct as determined by the department, a health care provider's recommendation or treatment provided as authorized under the right to try act is not grounds for the department to investigate under section 16221 or for disciplinary action against a licensee under section 16226.
